description: The interviewer agent invokes the nfs-new-book skill before asking any intake question when the book tree does not yet exist.

cases.given: intake interview starts and no project directory structure is present
cases.expect: nfs-new-book skill is invoked to scaffold the directory structure before the interview begins

cases.given: interviewer is dispatched for a new book and context/ does not exist
cases.expect: interviewer calls nfs-new-book so the scaffold appears before the first intake question
